/* === Header refinement per user request === */
.header-in{position:relative;height:86px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}
.header .brand{position:relative;z-index:2;gap:0;min-width:250px}
.header .brand img{display:none !important}
.header .brand-word{font:700 34px/1 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#1f1c18;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.header .brand-word span{color:#b48857;margin-left:4px}
.header nav{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);margin:0;gap:42px;align-items:center}
.header nav a{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;color:#625a52;letter-spacing:.01em}
.header nav a:hover{color:#1f1c18}
.header nav a:after{bottom:-10px;height:2px;background:#b48857}
.actions{margin-left:auto;gap:12px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.btn{min-height:52px;padding:0 22px;border-radius:0;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em}
.btn .btnicon{width:26px;height:26px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto}
.btn .btnicon img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.btn.call{padding-left:16px;padding-right:22px}
.btn.call .phoneicon{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:999px;background:#ece5dc;color:#1d1a16;padding:6px;transition:.2s}
.btn.call:hover .phoneicon{background:#fff;color:#239447}
.btn.max{padding-left:16px;padding-right:22px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7B4DFF 0%,#2B67FF 100%);border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(67,55,255,.18)}
.btn.max:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6b3fff 0%,#185dff 100%);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn.max .maxicon{width:28px;height:28px}
.btn.max .maxmark{width:28px;height:28px}
@media(max-width:1000px){
  .header-in{height:78px}
  .header .brand{min-width:auto}
  .header .brand-word{font-size:28px;letter-spacing:.14em}
}
@media(max-width:650px){
  .header .brand-word{font-size:24px;letter-spacing:.12em}
}


/* === Exact supplied phone + MAX artwork === */
.btn.call .phoneicon{width:32px;height:32px;padding:0;background:transparent;border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(24,110,33,.16)}
.btn.call .phoneicon img{width:32px;height:32px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:7px}
.btn.call:hover{background:#27a844;color:#fff;border-color:#27a844;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(39,168,68,.22)}
.btn.call:hover .phoneicon{background:transparent;color:inherit;box-shadow:0 2px 9px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}

.btn.max{background:#fff;color:#211e1a;border:1px solid #cdc5bb;box-shadow:none;padding-left:14px;padding-right:22px}
.btn.max .maxicon{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(63,61,196,.16)}
.btn.max .maxmark{width:32px;height:32px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px}
.btn.max span:last-child{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#2f2c31}
.btn.max:hover{background:#f8f6ff;border-color:#6d55ff;transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 9px 22px rgba(85,67,255,.12)}

@media(max-width:1000px){
 .btn.call .phoneicon,.btn.call .phoneicon img,.btn.max .maxicon,.btn.max .maxmark{width:30px;height:30px}
}


/* === FAKTURA FINAL HEADER + CATEGORY SCALE === */
/* Header as 3 columns: logo / centered menu / actions */
.header-in{
  height:84px;
  display:grid !important;
  grid-template-columns:290px minmax(420px,1fr) 365px;
  align-items:center;
  gap:20px;
  position:relative;
}
.header .brand{min-width:0 !important; justify-self:start; gap:0 !important;}
.header .brand img{display:none !important;}
.header .brand-word{font:700 32px/1 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;letter-spacing:.17em;color:#1f1c18;white-space:nowrap;}
.header .brand-word span{display:none !important;}
.header nav{
  position:static !important;
  transform:none !important;
  margin:0 !important;
  justify-self:center;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  gap:38px;
  width:max-content;
}
.header nav a{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:#625a52;white-space:nowrap;}
.actions{justify-self:end;margin:0 !important;display:flex;gap:12px;}
.btn{min-height:50px;padding:0 20px;font-size:12px;}
.btn.call{min-width:170px;}
.btn.max{min-width:120px;}

/* Main category title: elegant but not oversized */

/* Category cards: reduce the giant blocks */

.footer-v2{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 78% 35%,rgba(149,104,55,.09),transparent 34%),linear-gradient(180deg,#11100e,#0b0a09);color:#d8d0c7;padding:66px 0 26px;border-top:1px solid rgba(180,136,87,.18)}

.footer-v2-col{min-height:270px;padding:20px 46px;border-left:1px solid rgba(216,208,199,.16);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}

.hero.hero-image-only{background:#12110f;color:#fff}

.hero-hit.samples{left:21.0%;top:59.1%;width:18.0%;height:9.2%}

/* === V15: нежно светло-карамельная палитра вместо белых зон === */
:root{
  --caramel-base:#decfbf;
  --caramel-light:#e7d9ca;
  --caramel-soft:#e2d2c1;
  --caramel-deep:#d7c2aa;
  --caramel-border:#c9b49d;
}
body{background:var(--caramel-base)}
.header{
  background:rgba(231,217,202,.97) !important;
  border-bottom-color:var(--caramel-border) !important;
}
.services{background:var(--caramel-light);border-bottom-color:var(--caramel-border) !important}
.service{border-left-color:var(--caramel-border) !important}
.cream{background:var(--caramel-base) !important}
.warm{background:var(--caramel-soft) !important}
.product-body{background:var(--caramel-light) !important;border-color:var(--caramel-border) !important}
.product-img,.product-page>img{background:var(--caramel-soft) !important}
.section-head,.catalog-tools,.contacts3,.product-detail dl,.product-detail dl div{border-color:var(--caramel-border) !important}
.contacts3>div{border-right-color:var(--caramel-border) !important}
.filters button{border-color:var(--caramel-border) !important}
.btn.max{
  background:var(--caramel-light) !important;
  border-color:var(--caramel-border) !important;
}
.btn.max:hover{background:#efe4d8 !important}
.btn.light{background:var(--caramel-light) !important;color:#12110f !important}
.mobilepanel.open{background:var(--caramel-light);border-top-color:var(--caramel-border) !important}


/* === V16: реальные фотографии проектов === */
.projects-home,.projects-gallery{display:block}
.projects-showcase{display:grid;gap:24px;margin-top:42px}
.project-lead{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.08fr .92fr;border:1px solid #d8cfc5;background:#f8f4ee;overflow:hidden}
.project-lead-media img{width:100%;height:100%;aspect-ratio:16/11;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.project-lead-copy{padding:34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.project-kicker{display:block;color:#786f66;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em}
.project-lead h3{font:400 42px/1.04 Georgia,serif;margin:14px 0 0}
.project-lead p{margin:18px 0 0;color:#5f574f;line-height:1.7;font-size:15px}
.project-lead a,.project-card-copy a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:22px;color:#211e1a;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.project-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px}
.project-card-sm{display:grid;grid-template-columns:190px 1fr;gap:18px;border:1px solid #d8cfc5;background:#f8f4ee;overflow:hidden;min-width:0}
.project-card-sm img{width:100%;height:100%;aspect-ratio:1.02/1;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.project-card-copy{padding:18px 18px 18px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;min-width:0}
.project-card-copy small{display:block;color:#786f66;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
.project-card-copy h4{font:400 26px/1.08 Georgia,serif;margin:10px 0 0}
.project-card-copy p{margin:12px 0 0;color:#5f574f;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
@media(max-width:1000px){.project-lead{grid-template-columns:1fr}.project-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}.project-card-sm{grid-template-columns:180px 1fr}}
@media(max-width:650px){.projects-showcase{gap:18px;margin-top:28px}.project-lead-copy{padding:22px}.project-lead h3{font-size:32px}.project-lead p{font-size:14px;margin-top:14px}.project-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}.project-card-sm{grid-template-columns:124px 1fr;gap:14px}.project-card-copy{padding:14px 14px 14px 0}.project-card-copy h4{font-size:22px}.project-card-copy p{font-size:13px;margin-top:10px}.project-lead a,.project-card-copy a{margin-top:16px;font-size:11px}}

  .fm-down{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:50%;bottom:24px;width:22px;height:22px;border-right:2.5px solid #fff;border-bottom:2.5px solid #fff;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg)}
  .fm-contact{background:#e3cfb8;padding:29px 22px 25px;text-align:center}
  .fm-contact h2{font:400 30px/1.04 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;margin:0;color:#1d1712}
  .fm-contact-kicker{margin:9px 0 20px;font-size:7.4px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#776351}
  .fm-contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}
  .fm-contact-card{min-width:0;height:112px;border:1px solid rgba(102,76,51,.28);border-radius:13px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:#181411}
  .fm-contact-card img{width:50px;height:50px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%}
  .fm-sep{height:1px;background:rgba(102,76,51,.23);margin:20px 0}
  .fm-route{height:68px;border:1px solid rgba(102,76,51,.28);border-radius:12px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:45px 1fr 24px;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left;padding:9px 14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);color:#17130f}
  .fm-route img{width:43px;height:43px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:9px}
  .fm-route strong{font-size:16px;line-height:1.2}
  .fm-route .arr{font-size:30px;font-weight:200;line-height:1;text-align:right}
  .fm-address{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin-top:14px;color:#796653;font-size:13px}
  .fm-address .pin{font-size:19px}
  .fm-address small{display:block;font-size:6.5px;letter-spacing:.34em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:3px}
  #fakturaMobileShade{position:fixed;display:none;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.58);z-index:80}
  #fakturaMobileShade.open{display:block}
  #fakturaMobileMenu{display:block;position:fixed;z-index:90;top:0;right:0;width:min(88vw,390px);height:100dvh;overflow:auto;background:#e3cfb8;color:#1e1813;padding:27px 21px 30px;transform:translateX(102%);transition:transform .28s ease;box-shadow:-18px 0 45px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
  #fakturaMobileMenu.open{transform:translateX(0)}
  .fmm-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:28px}
  .fmm-logo{font:500 23px/1 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;letter-spacing:.25em}
  .fmm-logo small{display:block;font:600 6.5px/1 Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.38em;color:#a87647;margin-top:7px}
  .fmm-close{width:35px;height:35px;border:0;background:transparent;position:relative;cursor:pointer}
  .fmm-close:before,.fmm-close:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:5px;top:17px;width:28px;height:1.3px;background:#241b14}
  .fmm-close:before{transform:rotate(45deg)}.fmm-close:after{transform:rotate(-45deg)}
  .fmm-nav a{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px 1fr 18px;align-items:center;gap:12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(101,76,53,.24);padding:14px 2px;color:#1d1712}
  .fmm-ico{font-size:24px;text-align:center;color:#4f3b2a}.fmm-nav strong{display:block;font:400 29px/1 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif}.fmm-nav small{display:block;font-size:6.8px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#806b58;margin-top:5px}.fmm-arr{font-size:27px;font-weight:200}
  .fmm-contact-title{font:400 30px/1 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;margin:25px 0 7px}.fmm-contact-sub{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#806b58;margin:0 0 15px}
  .fmm-contact a{display:grid;grid-template-columns:45px 1fr 18px;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:67px;border:1px solid rgba(101,76,53,.27);border-radius:11px;margin-bottom:9px;padding:9px 11px;color:#1d1712;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
  .fmm-contact img{width:43px;height:43px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}.fmm-contact strong{font-size:16px}.fmm-contact small{display:block;font-size:6.5px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#826d59;margin-top:4px}
  .fmm-call{background:#2a211a!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#2a211a!important}.fmm-call .phone{font-size:27px;text-align:center}.fmm-call small{color:#d8c3b2!important}
  .fmm-route img{border-radius:8px!important}
}
@media(max-width:390px){
  .fm-hero{height:625px;min-height:625px}
  .fm-copy{top:145px}
  .fm-title{font-size:40px}
  .fm-contact{padding-left:17px;padding-right:17px}
  .fm-contact-grid{gap:9px}
  .fm-contact-card{height:106px}
  .fm-contact-card img{width:46px;height:46px}
}


/* === V23: mobile cleanup per approved screenshot === */
@media(max-width:900px){
  html,body{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;}
  body.mobile-home-active{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;}
  body.mobile-home-active>#fakturaMobileHome{display:block!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;position:relative!important;top:0!important;}
  body.mobile-home-active .fm-hero{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;top:0!important;}
  body.mobile-home-active>.header{display:none!important;}
  body.mobile-home-active>main#app{display:none!important;}
  /* Old desktop footer is not used in the mobile version. */
  .footer-v2{display:none!important;}
}


/* === V24: iPhone top safe-area cleanup + approved terminology === */
@media(max-width:900px){
  html{background:#12110f!important;}
  body.mobile-home-active{background:#12110f!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;}
  body.mobile-home-active>#fakturaMobileHome{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;top:0!important;transform:none!important;}
  body.mobile-home-active .fm-hero{margin:0!important;top:0!important;transform:none!important;}
}
@supports (padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top)){
  @media(max-width:900px){
    /* Let the hero image occupy the iPhone safe-area instead of showing a caramel strip. */
    body.mobile-home-active>#fakturaMobileHome{margin-top:calc(-1 * env(safe-area-inset-top))!important;}
    body.mobile-home-active .fm-hero{
      height:calc(650px + env(safe-area-inset-top))!important;
      min-height:calc(650px + env(safe-area-inset-top))!important;
    }
    .fm-top{top:calc(26px + env(safe-area-inset-top))!important;}
    .fm-copy{top:calc(150px + env(safe-area-inset-top))!important;}
    @media(max-width:390px){
      body.mobile-home-active .fm-hero{
        height:calc(625px + env(safe-area-inset-top))!important;
        min-height:calc(625px + env(safe-area-inset-top))!important;
      }
      .fm-copy{top:calc(145px + env(safe-area-inset-top))!important;}
    }
  }
}

    display:block!important;
  }

  .fmm-head{display:flex!important;justify-content:flex-end!important;align-items:center!important;margin:0 0 18px!important}
  .fmm-close{width:36px!important;height:36px!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important;position:relative!important;cursor:pointer!important;flex:0 0 auto}
  .fmm-close:before,.fmm-close:after{content:""!important;position:absolute!important;left:5px!important;top:17px!important;width:26px!important;height:1.5px!important;background:#241b14!important;border-radius:999px!important}
  .fmm-close:before{transform:rotate(45deg)!important}
  .fmm-close:after{transform:rotate(-45deg)!important}

  .fmm-nav{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;gap:0!important;margin:0!important}
  .fmm-nav a{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:32px 1fr 16px!important;align-items:center!important;gap:14px!important;padding:18px 0!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(36,27,20,.12)!important;color:#1d1712!important;background:none!important}
  .fmm-link-text{font-size:19px!important;line-height:1.2!important;letter-spacing:.03em!important;font-weight:400!important}
  .fmm-arr{font-size:22px!important;font-weight:300!important;color:#7a6c61!important;line-height:1!important}
  .fmm-ico{width:26px!important;height:26px!important;display:block!important;position:relative!important;color:#2a211a!important;opacity:.88}
  .fmm-ico:before,.fmm-ico:after{content:"";position:absolute;box-sizing:border-box}
  .fmm-ico-panels:before{inset:3px 4px 3px 4px;border-left:1.8px solid #2a211a;border-right:1.8px solid #2a211a;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#2a211a 0 2px,transparent 2px 6px)}
  .fmm-ico-projects:before{left:4px;right:4px;bottom:4px;height:15px;border:1.7px solid #2a211a;border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 2px 2px}
  .fmm-ico-projects:after{left:4px;right:4px;top:3px;margin:auto;width:18px;height:18px;border-top:1.7px solid #2a211a;border-left:1.7px solid #2a211a;transform:rotate(45deg)}
  .fmm-ico-useful:before{left:8px;top:3px;width:10px;height:10px;border:1.6px solid #2a211a;border-radius:50%}
  .fmm-ico-useful:after{left:10px;top:14px;width:6px;height:7px;border:1.6px solid #2a211a;border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 5px 5px;box-shadow:0 8px 0 -5px #2a211a}
  .fmm-ico-contacts:before{left:8px;top:3px;width:10px;height:10px;border:1.7px solid #2a211a;border-radius:50% 50% 50% 0;transform:rotate(-45deg)}
  .fmm-ico-contacts:after{left:11px;top:6px;width:4px;height:4px;background:#2a211a;border-radius:50%}

  .fmm-bottom{margin-top:14px!important;padding-top:6px!important}
  .fmm-messengers{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:16px!important;margin:0 0 14px!important}
  .fmm-msg{width:42px!important;height:42px!important;display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important}
  .fmm-msg img{width:36px!important;height:36px!important;border-radius:50%!important;display:block!important}

  .fmm-address-card{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:18px 1fr 16px!important;align-items:center!important;gap:12px!important;padding:8px 0 0!important;color:#6b6056!important;text-decoration:none!important;border-top:1px solid rgba(36,27,20,.08)!important}
  .fmm-address-pin{font-size:18px!important;line-height:1!important;color:#6b6056!important}
  .fmm-address-copy strong{display:block!important;font-size:16px!important;line-height:1.28!important;font-weight:500!important;color:#5f554c!important}
  .fmm-address-copy small{display:block!important;margin-top:4px!important;font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.2!important;letter-spacing:.12em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;color:#8e8174!important}
  .fmm-address-arrow{font-size:16px!important;line-height:1!important;color:#8e8174!important;text-align:right!important}

  .mobilepanel.open{background:#f4f1ed!important;border-top-color:rgba(36,27,20,.12)!important}
}


.panel-nav{display:flex;gap:38px;margin-left:auto;align-items:center}.panel-nav>a,.panel-nav summary{position:relative;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:#5f574f;transition:.2s;list-style:none;cursor:pointer}.panel-nav a:hover,.panel-nav summary:hover{color:#b48857}.panel-nav>a:after,.panel-nav summary:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-8px;height:1px;background:#b48857;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:.2s}.panel-nav>a:hover:after,.panel-nav summary:hover:after{transform:scaleX(1)}.nav-drop{position:relative}.nav-drop summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.nav-drop summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.nav-drop summary .nav-drop-arrow{font-size:13px;line-height:1;transform:translateY(1px)}.nav-drop[open] summary{color:#b48857}.nav-drop[open] summary:after{transform:scaleX(1)}.nav-drop-menu{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 24px);left:0;min-width:320px;padding:16px;border:1px solid #d8cfc5;background:#f8f4ee;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.08);display:grid;gap:8px}.nav-drop-menu a{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:12px 14px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3dbd0;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#3d352d}.nav-drop-menu a small{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8a7e72;font-weight:700}.nav-drop-menu a span:last-child{color:#b48857;font-size:16px}.nav-drop-menu a:hover{border-color:#b48857;transform:translateX(2px)}
.panel-folders-wrap{margin:0 0 34px}.panel-folders-copy{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:18px;margin-bottom:18px}.panel-folders-copy p{margin:0;color:#786f66;line-height:1.6;max-width:760px}.panel-folders{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}.panel-folder{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;min-height:150px;padding:22px;border:1px solid #d8cfc5;background:#f8f4ee;transition:.2s}.panel-folder:hover{border-color:#b48857;transform:translateY(-2px)}.panel-folder.active{background:#12110f;border-color:#12110f;color:#fff}.panel-folder.active .panel-folder-meta,.panel-folder.active .panel-folder-note{color:#d3c8bc}.panel-folder-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;align-items:start}.panel-folder h3{font:400 25px/1.12 Georgia,serif;margin:0}.panel-folder .panel-folder-arrow{font-size:20px;color:#b48857}.panel-folder-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-top:26px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8a7e72}.panel-folder-note{font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:#5f574f;margin-top:8px}.catalog-grid-title{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:18px;margin:12px 0 18px}.catalog-grid-title h2{font:400 34px/1.1 Georgia,serif;margin:0}.catalog-grid-title p{margin:0;color:#786f66;line-height:1.6}.catalog-grid-title .catalog-grid-badge{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8a7e72}.filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}

@media(max-width:1200px){.panel-nav{gap:28px}.nav-drop-menu{min-width:290px}.panel-folders{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}

@media(max-width:720px){.panel-folders{grid-template-columns:1fr}.panel-folder{min-height:auto}.searchbox{min-width:0;width:100%}.catalog-tools{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}.catalog-count{white-space:normal}}

.product-samples{background:#9d8265!important;border-color:#9d8265!important;color:#fff!important}

  .product-detail-card .eyebrow{margin:0 0 12px!important;color:#b48658!important;font-size:11px!important;font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:.11em!important}
  .product-detail-card h1{font-size:34px!important;line-height:1.04!important;margin:0 0 18px!important}

  .product-detail-card .bigprice{font-size:24px!important;margin:0 0 6px!important;font-weight:700!important}
  .product-detail-card .muted{font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.5!important;margin:0!important;color:#9b8b7c!important}

  .product-detail-card dl{margin-top:26px!important;border-top:1px solid #d8c8b8!important}

  .product-detail-card dt{font-size:13px!important;color:#8d7b6b!important}
  .product-detail-card dd{margin:0!important;text-align:right!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:#33271e!important}
